admissions.description:
MBZUAI in Abu Dhabi accepts applications for Fall 2027 graduate study until 15 December 2026 at 5pm Gulf Standard Time. Alongside its funded research MSc and PhD programmes, the university offers the Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence (MAAI), a fee-paying, 34-credit programme that receives no university or faculty funding.

Applicants need a STEM bachelor's degree such as computer science, electrical or computer engineering, mathematics or physics, and take an online screening exam in mathematics and programming. A subset of applicants is invited to a technical interview, and decisions are released by 31 March 2027, with offers to be accepted by 15 April 2027.

The programme suits African engineers and computer scientists who can fund their studies and want a practical AI master's at a specialised AI university. Applicants who also want a funded place should check the separate funded MSc route.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (computer science, electrical or computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar) from a recognised institution
Minimum CGPA of 3.0 or 3.5 out of 4.0, depending on the programme
Proof of English proficiency
Online screening exam in mathematics and programming
Technical interview if invited
Final-year students may apply with a transcript
admissions.financial_aid: The MAAI is self-funded and receives no university or faculty funding.

origin_notes.note: Degrees obtained outside the UAE need a UAE Ministry of Education Certificate of Recognition during the first semester.

admissions.how_to_apply: Apply through the MBZUAI online application portal before 15 December 2026, upload your documents and pay the AED 200 fee, then complete the screening exam. Only one application is allowed per cycle.
documents: Bachelor's transcript and degree certificate (or expected graduation letter)
admissions.selection_process: Applicants take an online screening exam (mathematics and programming); a subset is invited to a technical interview. Decisions are released by 31 March 2027.
admissions.about_provider: MBZUAI is a graduate research university in Abu Dhabi dedicated entirely to artificial intelligence. It offers master's and doctoral programmes in machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing and related fields.
admissions.notes: Degrees from outside the UAE need a Certificate of Recognition from the UAE Ministry of Education, to be provided in the first semester.

admissions.title: Undergraduate admission for high school applicants (Fall 2027)

admissions.description:
Simon Fraser University's fall 2027 undergraduate round for secondary-school applicants runs from 1 October 2026 to 31 January 2027, and it covers roughly 368 undergraduate programmes across its Burnaby, Surrey and Vancouver campuses. Applications go through EducationPlannerBC, and applicants then track their document checklist in goSFU.

Applicants studying outside Canada must submit interim transcripts showing final grade 11 results and grade 12 courses in progress. The deadline is 28 February for most applicants, but earlier for those applying for an entrance scholarship (31 January) or to the Beedie School of Business (7 February). Offers are made on a rolling basis between January and June.

SFU also runs the Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarship, whose application window is 1 October to 15 December, so African students hoping for merit funding should apply early.

Interim transcript with final grade 11 grades and grade 12 courses in progress
IB applicants submit a predicted grades form
Programme-specific requirements on SFU's requirements pages
admissions.financial_aid: SFU offers entrance scholarships, including the Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarship (application 1 October to 15 December), plus other awards and bursaries; eligibility details are on SFU's scholarship pages.

documents: Documents requested on the goSFU to-do list
admissions.selection_process: Admissions reviews the application once all required documents are submitted; offers are made on a rolling basis from January to June.
important_dates: Interim transcripts from outside Canada: 28 February 2027 (31 January for scholarship applicants, 7 February for Beedie)
Accept offer by 1 May for guaranteed residence
admissions.about_provider: Simon Fraser University is a public research university in British Columbia, Canada, with campuses in Burnaby, Surrey and Vancouver. It is known for its interdisciplinary programmes and co-op education.

admissions.deadline_note: The page states that Fall 2027 undergraduate applications are accepted until 1 February 2027; it does not give a separate date for international applicants.

admissions.description:
Khalifa University in Abu Dhabi has opened undergraduate admission for Fall 2027 and accepts applications until 1 February 2027. The round covers its bachelor's degrees in engineering (aerospace, biomedical, chemical, civil, computer, electrical, energy, mechanical and petroleum), robotics and AI, engineering systems and management, computer science, applied mathematics, statistics and data science, physics, chemistry, cell and molecular biology, and earth and planetary sciences.

Applicants must have finished secondary school within the last two years with mathematics and at least one science subject. Shortlisted applicants take the KU Admission Test, a 90-minute computer-based mathematics test, and a recorded video interview, and the university then decides on the basis of these results and school grades.

African applicants need their school certificate recognised and attested through the UAE Ministry of Education, which can take time, so it is wise to start early. Merit scholarships are considered automatically and are shown in the offer.

Mathematics plus one science (physics, chemistry or biology, depending on the programme)
IB applicants: full diploma with at least 24 points and at least 4 in each subject
IELTS Academic 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 79
SAT Mathematics 700 preferred
KU Admission Test (90 minutes, 40 multiple-choice maths questions) for shortlisted applicants
admissions.financial_aid: Merit-based scholarships covering full or partial tuition, and sometimes textbooks and accommodation, are considered automatically and included in the offer.

documents: Attested secondary school certificates and transcripts for Grades 10-12 with grading scale
admissions.selection_process: Shortlisted applicants sit the KU Admission Test and a video-recorded interview; the admissions team then evaluates test results together with school grades. Incomplete applications are not considered.

Applications completed before the first consideration date of 22 January 2027 get priority for both admission and graduate funding; later applications are reviewed only if places remain. Files are assessed only once every document, including the letters of recommendation, has arrived.

For African graduates, TMU offers practice-oriented programmes in engineering, business, media, urban planning and health in the centre of Toronto. Checking the specific programme deadline early is essential because popular programmes close sooner.

admissions.description:
The Faculty of Information Technology at the Czech Technical University in Prague offers English-taught master's programmes in Informatics and Applied Informatics. For the 2027/28 year, applications open on 1 January 2027 and must be submitted by 31 March 2027, with each specialisation requiring its own application.

Admission has two steps: a 90-minute written test scored out of 100 (60 points needed to continue) and a 15-minute interview in English. Applicants upload a structured CV by 7 April, sit the test and interview in late April or early May, and receive results by 21 May 2027. Final documents are due by 13 September and tuition by 15 September 2027.

The programmes are fee-paying but relatively affordable for Europe. African applicants must have their bachelor's degree recognised in Czechia and should start visa preparations as soon as they are admitted.

English at B2 or higher (for example IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 72; Duolingo not accepted)

admissions.selection_process: Applicants are ranked on points from the admission test and interview, within the faculty's capacity. Recent FIT bachelor's graduates are exempt from the test and interview.
important_dates: Test and interview: late April to early May 2027
admissions.about_provider: The Czech Technical University in Prague (CTU) is one of the oldest technical universities in Europe. Its Faculty of Information Technology teaches computer science and software engineering at bachelor's, master's and doctoral levels.

admissions.description:
San José State University in the heart of Silicon Valley accepts international (F-1 and J-1) applicants to its graduate programmes for fall 2027, with applications opening on 1 August 2026. Each programme sets its own application and document deadlines, ranging from 1 December 2026 to 1 April 2027.

The programmes include master's degrees in engineering, computer science, data science, business analytics, finance, social work, public health and more. Some, such as the MS in Computer Science, require a specific four-year bachelor's degree, in that case in computer science or computer engineering.

For African graduates aiming at technology careers, SJSU's location and industry links are a major draw. Check your programme's row in the deadline table carefully, because document deadlines usually follow about three weeks after the application deadline.

admissions.description:
The University of Debrecen in eastern Hungary runs a large range of English-taught degree programmes for self-financing international students. For the September 2027 intake, applications for all programmes close on 15 May 2027; the January/February 2027 intake closed on 1 November 2026.

Applicants complete an online form, upload their education certificates and transcripts in English, a CV, a passport copy and a medical certificate, and pay a USD 150 application fee. Admission is then decided through an entrance exam or interview. Master's applicants also send a detailed transcript with course descriptions.

Debrecen is popular with African students, especially in medicine, engineering and agriculture. Students who want a Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship must apply separately through the Tempus portal rather than this self-financed route.

admissions.description:
The University of Sheffield opened applications for taught master's courses starting in September 2027 on 15 September 2026. Applicants who need a visa to study in the UK must apply by 26 August 2027, a week before the general closing date of 3 September 2027.

The page also sets out the steps that follow an offer: CAS applications begin in June 2027 and should be made by 6 September, ATAS clearance (needed for some science and engineering courses) should be requested by 16 August because it takes at least 30 working days, and teaching begins on 27 September 2027 after orientation and welcome weeks.

A small number of courses also start in February 2027, with a visa-applicant cut-off of 4 January 2027. African applicants should apply early to leave time for visa processing.

admissions.deadline_note: Kent's international deadlines page gives 31 August 2027 as the application deadline for undergraduate and taught postgraduate courses starting in September 2027; research courses and the PGT Forensic Psychology course close on 2 July 2027.
admissions.description:
The University of Kent publishes a single set of admission deadlines for international students. For the September 2027 intake, undergraduate and taught master's applications from international students are accepted until 31 August 2027, while research degrees (and the taught Forensic Psychology programme) close earlier, on 2 July 2027.

The late deadline does not mean applicants should wait. Students who need a UK Student visa must show the required funds by 18 August 2027 under the UKVI 28-day rule, pay deposits by late August, accept offers by 8 September and receive a CAS by 17 September, with teaching starting on 25 September 2027.

For African applicants this means applying several months ahead, because offers, deposits and visa paperwork all have to be in place before the August cut-off dates.
